hero.lede: Independent practitioner working from our Bangor Medical Centre premises. Nephrologist & General Medicine Physician. Consulting in English, Cantonese, Mandarin.

paragraphs: Dr Christina Lai is a Nephrologist and General Medicine Physician (ABN: 49 369 076 383) (MED0001602956) consulting at the Bangor centre.

Dr. Christina Lai is a patient-centred nephrologist and a general physician passionate about empowering patients and families to fully engage in their medical care through active listening, expressing empathy and education. Dr Lai graduated from the University of New South Wales in Sydney and completed her basic physicians training at St. Vincent’s Hospital. She was awarded her Fellowship with the Royal Australian College of Physicians (FRACP) upon completing her specialist training in renal medicine through Liverpool Hospital, Concord Hospital and Royal Prince Alfred Hospital.

Dr Lai has special interest in treating patients with acute kidney injury, hypertension, renal stone disease, cardiorenal syndrome and chronic kidney diseases, including those requiring dialysis and transplantation. Dr Lai also previously conducted a series of talks on SBS Cantonese Radio on common kidney problems.
Dr Lai speaks fluent Cantonese and Mandarin in addition to English.
